suggested_requirements.text: The system shall allow the creation of new user accounts.
The system shall allow users to modify their own password, email address, and name.
The system shall allow the deactivation of user accounts.
The system shall allow users to reset their own password.
The system shall allow the association of Mashbot accounts with external service accounts.
The system shall provide an interface for authenticating a user account to an external service account.
The system shall provide a standardized method of interacting with external service accounts.
The system shall allow users to schedule content for various services to be published concurrently.
The system shall allow users to view and compare historical metrics of campaigns.
The system shall allow users to view and create replies to content.
The system shall allow the maintenance of users and approvers of content.
The system shall allow users to set up keyword alerts for watched services.
The system shall encrypt data over a direct connection between the web client and the server using TLS.
The system shall allow for the backup of the data system to local or remote non-volatile storage systems.
The system shall allow only valid, non-disabled users to log into the system.
The system shall require a valid username and password for user authentication.
The system shall allow the System Administrator to configure a timeout after which a user is automatically logged out.
The Mashbot server shall require no greater than 1 gigabyte of RAM memory.
The web client shall require no more than 256 megabytes of RAM.
Full system backups shall not interfere with user interaction for more than 10 minutes.
